notes: §2002:8.8.4.1.6.2 GR1: an operand is positive if its value is greater than zero, negative if less, zero if equal to zero; under standard arithmetic the operand is a 32-digit item compared with zero. The witness IF B * 100 + 9 - B * 100 IS ZERO is true (the 33-digit sum is cut to 10^32, minus 10^32 is 0), where 34 digits gave 9.
